content:
Specify the exact video length and pacing in the prompt (e.g., 15-second energetic cinematic montage, constant movement, fast-paced editing) to drive dynamic cuts.

Use a structured prompt with sections like Prompt / Main subject / Music / Style / Audio / Negative prompts to control multiple aspects of the generation.

Add camera and lens direction keywords (ultra-wide-angle, handheld, selfie-style close-up, tracking shot, low-angle, camera slowly pulls back) to shape shot composition and movement.

Break the video into timestamped beats (e.g., [00:00-00:02], [00:02-00:04]…) and describe each shot to guide scene progression and editing rhythm.

Explicitly request audio behavior from the first second and throughout (music starts immediately, nonstop rhythm, ASMR cooking sounds layered with music, street chatter, honking) to influence sound design.

Use negative prompts to exclude unwanted aesthetics and pacing (e.g., luxury restaurant, quiet environment, staged cooking, modern clean kitchen, low energy, slow pacing, blurry footage, cartoon visuals).

es.content:
Especifica la duración exacta del video y el ritmo en el prompt (por ejemplo, montaje cinematográfico energético de 15 segundos, movimiento constante, edición rápida) para impulsar cortes dinámicos.

Usa un prompt estructurado con secciones como Prompt / Tema principal / Música / Estilo / Audio / Prompts negativos para controlar múltiples aspectos de la generación.

Añade palabras clave de dirección de cámara y lente (ultra gran angular, cámara en mano, primer plano estilo selfie, toma de seguimiento, ángulo bajo, cámara retrocede lentamente) para dar forma a la composición y movimiento de las tomas.

Divide el video en ritmos con marcas de tiempo (por ejemplo, [00:00-00:02], [00:02-00:04]…) y describe cada toma para guiar la progresión de la escena y el ritmo de edición.

Solicita explícitamente el comportamiento del audio desde el primer segundo y a lo largo del video (la música comienza inmediatamente, ritmo incesante, sonidos de cocina ASMR mezclados con música, charla callejera, bocinazos) para influir en el diseño de sonido.

Usa prompts negativos para excluir estéticas y ritmos no deseados (por ejemplo, restaurante de lujo, ambiente tranquilo, cocina escenificada, cocina moderna y limpia, baja energía, ritmo lento, metraje borroso, visuales de dibujos animados).

在提示中指定确切的视频长度和节奏（例如，15秒充满活力的电影蒙太奇，持续运动，快速剪辑）以推动动态剪辑。

使用结构化提示，包括提示/主要主题/音乐/风格/音频/负面提示等部分，以控制生成的多个方面。

添加相机和镜头方向关键词（超广角、手持、自拍式特写、跟踪镜头、低角度、相机慢慢拉远）来塑造镜头构图和运动。

将视频分解为带时间戳的节拍（例如，[00:00-00:02]，[00:02-00:04]…），并描述每个镜头以指导场景进展和编辑节奏。

明确要求从第一秒开始并贯穿整个音频行为（音乐立即开始，不间断节奏，ASMR烹饪声音与音乐层叠，街头喧闹声，鸣笛声）以影响声音设计。

使用负面提示排除不需要的美学和节奏（例如，豪华餐厅，安静环境，摆拍烹饪，现代干净厨房，低能量，慢节奏，模糊画面，卡通视觉）。

Main subject:
Hardworking Indian street food vendor cooking at a busy roadside stall beside heavy city traffic. Sweaty face, fast hands, realistic street kitchen, giant wok of boiling oil, colorful sauces and spices everywhere.

Music:
Energetic Indian street-style music starts immediately from the first second — upbeat dhol drums, tabla rhythm, festive brass, fast Bollywood-style percussion, nonstop lively rhythm throughout the entire video.

[00:00-00:02]
HOOK SHOT. Ultra-wide-angle selfie-style close-up of the vendor at the frying station while oil violently sizzles beside him. Camera distortion from wide lens creates immersive realism. Loud Indian music immediately starts.

Traffic rushing behind him.
People shouting food orders.

[00:02-00:04]
Fast handheld shots:
— batter dropped into boiling oil
— flames bursting under giant wok
— vendor rapidly flipping snacks
— close-up of bubbling oil exploding

ASMR cooking sounds layered with music.

Wide-angle tracking shot of customers crowding the stall, exchanging cash quickly, grabbing hot food plates, constant movement everywhere.

People talking in Hindi.
Motorcycles passing loudly.

[00:06-00:08]
Rapid montage:
— green chutney poured dramatically
— chopped onions flying onto hot plate
— spice powder thrown in slow arc
— tea steaming
— customers eating immediately beside the road

Music intensifies.

[00:08-00:10]
Dynamic low-angle shot from inside the stall looking outward toward the busy street. Vendor works nonstop at incredible speed while multiple customers wait impatiently.

Sweat shines realistically under afternoon sunlight.

[00:10-00:12]
Ultra-fast cuts synchronized perfectly to music beats:
— frying
— plating
— customers smiling
— money exchanged
— wok tossing food
— steam hitting the camera lens
— close-up of crispy street snacks

[00:12-00:15]
Final cinematic wide-angle shot of the entire roadside stall during peak rush hour. Vendor still cooking rapidly while traffic, smoke, people, and music create overwhelming vibrant energy.

Camera slowly pulls back into the chaotic Indian street atmosphere.
